# Static binary evidence

Generated by file/binutils in a Landlock/seccomp sandbox; target never executed.
Binary SHA-256: `5a9327f87f994a76c84c986a498e105be183a558b520fe6004ceb6e498a7489d`.

File identification:

```text
PE32 executable (console) Intel 80386, for MS Windows, 9 sections
```

Source correspondence findings:

Commit 822c070f87d1104283ffbd4ce0bdac0f1dde9c4f updates binary, tls.c and TLS.vcxproj together. Project uses v140; PE CodeView points to AngrTests\Debug\TLS.pdb. Ghidra bodies 0x4116c0 (increment), 0x411730 (main), 0x411800 (decrement) agree. FS:[0x2c] and _tls_index select storage; application TLS offset is +0x104. CreateThread gets 0x41135c, a jump thunk to the worker.

Compiler markers are object-level hints, not proof of complete build flags:

No retained GCC marker; see ground truth for available build metadata.
